constraints: If aTable is omitted, the command applies to the default table.

selector must be one of the predefined constants from the "Database Parameters" theme; the meaning, scope, and valid values of the value parameter depend entirely on which selector constant is passed (documented per-constant in a large reference table).
_needsReview: value's TypeRef is a simple Real/Text union with no per-selector discrimination -- the docs define dozens of distinct selector constants each with its own value semantics (thread-safety, scope, persistence across sessions), which is too large/volatile a mapping to safely encode here without an enums{} entry sourced from the full constants table.
